crime: Months ago, her friend asked {WITCH_NAME} to clear the dining hall every evening. Since she agreed, dishes and pots had put themselves away along the same route each night. Soon all the girls brought her chores, and she never refused.
Lately her friend had stopped asking. That evening, right in front of {WITCH_NAME}, the friend handed another girl her torn hem to mend without once turning to her.

The friend always ate alone after the others left. That night, while {WITCH_NAME} sat with the girls in the lounge, she directed the soup pot above her friend's seat and overturned its boiling contents onto her.

At breakfast they found the body beneath the pot. Burns ran down the head and back, while the palms were unmarked: the friend had never reached up to pull it down. The spill was two tables away from the clearing's usual route. The pots moved as {WITCH_NAME} intended, and this one had gone straight to her friend's seat.
fields.epitaph: Every favor kept, and no one kept her.
fields.epithet: A Place Kept With Every Yes
execution: An iron frame closed around her limbs and back. When she moved an arm, the frame forced it to its limit and locked it there. When her knees bent, it folded them fully and held them. At last she sagged forward; the frame folded her against her own chest until she could no longer breathe.

magic.name: Standing Yes
magic.text: A favor she agrees to aloud carries itself out.
